description: Add a paper to a collection, addressed by collection_id OR collection_name (get-or-create by name — no need to look up an id first). Nest with "/": collection_name "AgentOPA/Formal" files the paper under an "AgentOPA" folder. MUTATES: also auto-saves the paper to the library. Idempotent (adding a paper already in the collection is a no-op). Requires SF_API_KEY.

arxiv_id.description: arXiv ID of the paper to add, e.g. '2407.15831'.

collection_id.description: UUID of an existing collection. Provide this OR collection_name.

collection_name.description: Name of the collection. Created if it doesn't exist. Use '/' to nest, e.g. 'AgentOPA/Formal'. Provide this OR collection_id.

name: add_to_collection

action.description: Machine label: saved | no_change | removed | liked | created | updated | deleted.

title: Add to Collection
